name: Hayase Russian Subs
description: Russian subtitles from Anime365 with an OpenSubtitles fallback, matched by title and episode.

adapterUrl.description: Optional CORS-compatible fallback adapter URL. Leave empty to use Anime365 and OpenSubtitles through the project Worker.

subtitleProxyUrl.description: Optional override for the bundled subtitle Worker. Leave empty to use the public project Worker.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of Russian subtitle tracks returned for one episode.
